title: Breath of the Wild Outsold the Nintendo Switch in Its Launch Month
hook:
In March 2017 Breath of the Wild sold 925,000 copies on Switch in the US while the Switch itself sold 906,000 units. Have you ever bought two copies of the same game?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Breath of the Wild sold more copies than the Nintendo Switch itself in the console's launch month? In March two thousand seventeen the Switch arrived in the United States alongside The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. In April Nintendo announced the numbers, using sales data from the NPD Group. The Switch sold more than 906,000 units in the United States that month. That made it the fastest selling video game system in Nintendo's history. But Breath of the Wild on Switch sold more than 925,000 copies in the same month. That is more games than consoles. Nintendo had an explanation. Some fans bought a limited edition of the game to collect, and a second regular copy to actually play. Then add the Wii U version, which sold about 460,000 copies. Breath of the Wild passed 1.3 million copies in the United States in a single month. Those numbers combined physical and digital sales, and they only covered the United States. In Nintendo's own words, the game had an attach rate of more than one hundred percent. Have you ever bought two copies of the same game? Follow for more gaming history.
